name: agent-notepad
description: Persistent, per-objective working memory for coding agents — one standalone git notepad per objective that survives compaction, spans multiple code repos from a single session, keeps an append-only journal, and mirrors into an episodic memory index. Evolves and supersedes handoff-auto.
$comment: The four USER-LEVEL Notes hooks declared here mirror what install.sh merges into ~/.claude/settings.json (that path uses ${HOME}/.claude/hooks/agent-notepad/...; this plugin path uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} per DESIGN §15). The PreToolUse commit gate is intentionally NOT declared here — it ships in the notepad template's .claude/settings.json so it arms ONLY inside a notepad session (DESIGN §7.6/§15). The digest builder (hooks/digest-build.sh) is a standalone script triggered by a debounced Stop or a scheduled job, not a native hook event, so it is not declared here either.
